name: o-json: copy paths and values from FLAT

actions.label: Jump from a value to its structure
actions.caption: enter jumps from the FLAT name line to its structure field. Find where an interesting value belongs in the document.

actions.label: Choose what to copy
actions.caption: y starts the FLAT copy chord. Choose y for the whole line, p for its path, or v for its value.

actions.label: Copy the whole FLAT line
actions.caption: y y copies the displayed path and value together. Keep an explanation of both the location and the data.

actions.label: Copy only the path
actions.caption: y p copies the concrete path to this name. Paste it into jq or another tool without copying the displayed value.

actions.label: Copy only the value
actions.caption: y v copies just the name value. Reuse the JSON data without carrying its path along.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
